parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(i=>{const raw=String(i.json.url||"").trim();let valid=false,protocol="",host="",error="";try{const u=new URL(raw);protocol=u.protocol;host=u.hostname;valid=["https:","http:"].includes(u.protocol)&&!!u.hostname;if(!valid)error="Only HTTP/HTTPS URLs with a hostname are accepted.";}catch(e){error="Invalid URL format.";}return {json:{...i.json,url:raw,isValid:valid,protocol,hostname:host,error,checkedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}});
